negative_reviews.author: Frank Ng
negative_reviews.text: Food average,there are better ramen out there,good atmosphere and  deco

negative_reviews.author: Anya Fitzpatrick
negative_reviews.text: My friend and I ate here yesterday. Within an hour we were both violently unwell with food poisoning.

negative_reviews.author: Denise Cariaga
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) I ordered the beef ramen and it was good, though the broth could have had a bit more beef flavor. It bothered me that, being in a Western country, the default option isn't traditional meat. Since when is all the meat served here from halal slaughter?
Food for thought! There was no non-halal option.

(Original)
Pedí el ramen de vacuno y estaba bueno, tal vez el caldo podría haber tenido un poco más de sabor a carne. Me molestó que estando en un país occidental, la opción por defecto no sea carne tradicional. ¿¿¿Desde cuándo toda la carne servida aquí es por matanza halal???
¡Para pensar! No tenía la opción de comida no halal
